ingredients.raw_kh: ឬចេកពងមាន់
ម្សៅកញ្ចប់រូបកុមារ៉ាល់ហោះ
ស៊ីអ៊ីវខាប់

steps.text_kh: ចេកត្រូវពុះជាបួនទុកសិន យកម្សៅខ្សាយលាយជាមួយម្សៅរូបកុមារ៉ាល់ហោះដាក់បន្តិច
steps.text_en: Halve the bananas lengthwise; mix rice flour with a little Flying Boy flour mix.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Chek Chien (Fried Bananas), step 1: Halve the bananas lengthwise; mix rice flour with a little Flying Boy flour mix.

steps.text_kh: ពងទាយកតែសលាយជាមួយម្សៅឱ្យសព្វ ចាក់ស៊ីអ៊ីវបន្តិច ដាក់អំបិលបន្តិច
steps.text_en: Beat egg white into the flour until smooth; add a little cooking wine and salt.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Chek Chien (Fried Bananas), step 2: Beat egg white into the flour until smooth; add a little cooking wine and salt.

steps.text_kh: យកល្ង ដូងពុះយកក្បាលខ្ទិះចាក់លាយម្សៅ រួចយកសាច់ដូងដែលកោសដាក់ចូលខ្លះ
steps.text_en: Grate turmeric and coconut head into the batter; add some grated coconut flesh.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Chek Chien (Fried Bananas), step 3: Grate turmeric and coconut head into the batter; add some grated coconut flesh.

steps.text_kh: ដាំខ្លាញ់ឱ្យក្តៅទើបយកចេកទៅជ្រលក់នឹងម្សៅ បង់ក្នុងខ្លាញ់ឱ្យឡើងក្រហមស្រួយ ជាការស្រេច
steps.text_en: Heat oil; dip bananas in the batter and fry until golden and crisp.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer dessert dish Chek Chien (Fried Bananas), step 4: Heat oil; dip bananas in the batter and fry until golden and crisp.
